summary: This Form 6-K by InterContinental Hotels Group PLC reports routine daily repurchases of its own ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange via Goldman Sachs International from May 29 through June 12, 2026. The purchases, authorized at the May 2025 AGM, are open-market buybacks totaling tens of thousands of shares per day at prices around $152-$159 per share, with intent to cancel. No tender offer, premium, or special event is involved; the filing is a standard disclosure of share buyback activity under UK rules and SEC requirements for foreign private issuers.
